digest.component_or_area: plan-review G7 criterion routing and rubric
propositions: G7 routing entry must change from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.85 to enable plan-review blocking for floor-grade divergences, with 0/348 false positives at >= 0.85 threshold across historical findings.

G7 rubric must add four rules: abstain-on-unresolvable-parent (FAIL-OPEN), closed-parent-final-state + sibling-handoff scope carve-out, one-finding-per-contradicted-parent-clause dedup, and floor-kind guidance (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site only, not incomplete_enumeration cosmetic mismatches).

Plan-review blocking mechanism admits both contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor kinds at impact 0.85+ via existing ADR-0054 divergence grading; incomplete_enumeration caps at 0.55 impact and cannot block via this axis.

Pinned blocking-set assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking') pair via new G7_BLOCKING constant and posture-pin update.
